mapper.select: SELECT IPVRSN_NO, IPROM_NO, SFULL_ITEM, SITEM, SSUB_ITEM, SMOVE_FULL_ITEM, SUNIT_TYPE, SNATIVE_TYPE, SSTYLE_ID, ILEVEL, IINDEX, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SSEARCH_TEXT, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SGAEJUNG_HIDE_YN, SUSER_MODIFIED_YN, SDISP_YN, SSTART_DT, SINS_DT, SSYS_ID, NULL AS RANK FROM TB_PROV_VRSN WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} ORDER BY ILEVEL, IINDEX, SFULL_ITEM

SELECT IPVRSN_NO, IPROM_NO, SFULL_ITEM, SITEM, SSUB_ITEM, SMOVE_FULL_ITEM, SUNIT_TYPE, SNATIVE_TYPE, SSTYLE_ID, ILEVEL, IINDEX, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SSEARCH_TEXT, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SGAEJUNG_HIDE_YN, SUSER_MODIFIED_YN, SDISP_YN, SSTART_DT, SINS_DT, SSYS_ID, NULL AS RANK FROM TB_PROV_VRSN WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND SFULL_ITEM = #{fullItem}

SELECT PV.IPVRSN_NO, PV.IPROM_NO, PV.SFULL_ITEM, PV.SITEM, PV.SSUB_ITEM, PV.SMOVE_FULL_ITEM, PV.SUNIT_TYPE, PV.SNATIVE_TYPE, PV.SSTYLE_ID, PV.ILEVEL, PV.IINDEX, PV.STITLE, PV.SCONTENTS, PV.SREASON, PV.SSEARCH_TEXT, PV.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, PV.SGAEJUNG_HIDE_YN, PV.SUSER_MODIFIED_YN, PV.SDISP_YN, PV.SSTART_DT, PV.SINS_DT, PV.SSYS_ID, NULL AS RANK FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV JOIN TB_PROM PR ON PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO WHERE PR.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND PV.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(PV.SFULL_ITEM, 1, 30) = SUBSTR(#{fullItem}, 1, 30) AND (PR.ILAW_NO, PV.SFULL_ITEM) IN ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO), PV2.SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2 JOIN TB_PROM PR2 ON PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO WHERE PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND PV2.SDISP_YN = 'Y' AND SUBSTR(PV2.SFULL_ITEM, 1, 30) = SUBSTR(#{fullItem}, 1, 30) GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) ORDER BY PV.SFULL_ITEM
mapper.sql: IPVRSN_NO, IPROM_NO, SFULL_ITEM, SITEM, SSUB_ITEM, SMOVE_FULL_ITEM, SUNIT_TYPE, SNATIVE_TYPE, SSTYLE_ID, ILEVEL, IINDEX, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SSEARCH_TEXT, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SGAEJUNG_HIDE_YN, SUSER_MODIFIED_YN, SDISP_YN, SSTART_DT, SINS_DT, SSYS_ID, NULL AS RANK

SELECT PV.IPVRSN_NO, PV.IPROM_NO, PV.SFULL_ITEM, PV.SITEM, PV.SSUB_ITEM, PV.SMOVE_FULL_ITEM, PV.SUNIT_TYPE, PV.SNATIVE_TYPE, PV.SSTYLE_ID, PV.ILEVEL, PV.IINDEX, PV.STITLE, PV.SCONTENTS, PV.SREASON, PV.SSEARCH_TEXT, PV.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, PV.SGAEJUNG_HIDE_YN, PV.SUSER_MODIFIED_YN, PV.SDISP_YN, PV.SSTART_DT, PV.SINS_DT, PR.SSYS_ID, NULL AS RANK
WHERE PV.SFULL_ITEM = M.SFULL_ITEM AND PR.ILAW_NO = M.ILAW_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND NVL(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ORDER BY PV.SFULL_ITEM
mapper.select: FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS ILAW_NO, PV2.SFULL_ITEM AS SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND PV2.SNATIVE_TYPE = 'F_JANG' GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) M

FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS ILAW_NO, PV2.SFULL_ITEM AS SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND PV2.SUNIT_TYPE = 'BASE_TEXT' GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) M
SELECT IPROM_NO FROM TB_PROM WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} FOR UPDATE

FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS ILAW_NO, PV2.SFULL_ITEM AS SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) M

FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS ILAW_NO, PV2.SFULL_ITEM AS SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} AND PV2.SFULL_ITEM <> #{parentFullItem} AND ( ( PV2.SUNIT_TYPE = 'BASE_TEXT' AND SUBSTR(RPAD(PV2.SFULL_ITEM, 60, '0'), 1, 25) = SUBSTR(RPAD(#{parentFullItem}, 60, '0'), 1, 25) ) OR ( PV2.SNATIVE_TYPE = 'F_JEOL' AND SUBSTR(RPAD(PV2.SFULL_ITEM, 60, '0'), 1, 10) = SUBSTR(RPAD(#{parentFullItem}, 60, '0'), 1, 10) AND SUBSTR(RPAD(#{parentFullItem}, 60, '0'), 11, 5) = '00000' ) ) GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) M
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROV_VRSN SET STITLE = #{title}, SCONTENTS = #{contents,jdbcType=CLOB}, SREASON = #{reason,jdbcType=CLOB}, SGAEJUNG_TYPE = #{gaejungType}, SSTART_DT = #{startDate}, SUSER_MODIFIED_YN = 'Y' WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND SFULL_ITEM = #{fullItem}
mapper.insert:
INSERT ALL
INTO TB_PROV_VRSN ( IPVRSN_NO, IPROM_NO, SFULL_ITEM, SITEM, SSUB_ITEM, SMOVE_FULL_ITEM, SUNIT_TYPE, SNATIVE_TYPE, SSTYLE_ID, ILEVEL, IINDEX, STITLE, SCONTENTS, SREASON, SSEARCH_TEXT, SGAEJUNG_TYPE, SGAEJUNG_HIDE_YN, SUSER_MODIFIED_YN, SDISP_YN, SSTART_DT, SINS_DT ) VALUES ( #{v.provVrsnNo}, #{v.promNo}, #{v.fullItem}, #{v.item}, #{v.subItem}, #{v.moveFullItem}, #{v.unitType}, #{v.nativeType}, #{v.styleId}, #{v.level}, #{v.index}, #{v.title}, #{v.contents,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{v.reason,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{v.searchText,jdbcType=CLOB}, #{v.gaejungType}, #{v.gaejungHideYn}, #{v.userModifiedYn}, #{v.dispYn}, #{v.startDate}, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') )
SELECT * FROM DUAL
mapper.select: WITH LP AS (SELECT ILAW_ID, ILAW_NO FROM TB_PROM WHERE IPROM_NO = #{leftPromNo}), RP AS (SELECT ILAW_ID, ILAW_NO FROM TB_PROM WHERE IPROM_NO = #{rightPromNo}), L_CUM AS ( SELECT PV.SFULL_ITEM, PV.SCONTENTS FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS ILAW_NO, PV2.SFULL_ITEM AS SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2, LP WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = LP.ILAW_ID AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= LP.ILAW_NO GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) M, LP WHERE PV.SFULL_ITEM = M.SFULL_ITEM AND PR.ILAW_NO = M.ILAW_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = LP.ILAW_ID AND PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND NVL(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ), R_CUM AS ( SELECT PV.SFULL_ITEM, PV.SCONTENTS, PV.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, PV.SMOVE_FULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS ILAW_NO, PV2.SFULL_ITEM AS SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2, RP WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = RP.ILAW_ID AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= RP.ILAW_NO GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) M, RP WHERE PV.SFULL_ITEM = M.SFULL_ITEM AND PR.ILAW_NO = M.ILAW_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = RP.ILAW_ID AND PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND NVL(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' ) SELECT NVL(L.SFULL_ITEM, R.SFULL_ITEM) AS FULL_ITEM, L.SCONTENTS AS LEFT_TEXT, R.SCONTENTS AS RIGHT_TEXT, R.SGAEJUNG_TYPE AS GAEJUNG_TYPE, R.SMOVE_FULL_ITEM AS MOVE_FULL_ITEM, CASE WHEN L.SFULL_ITEM IS NULL THEN 'ADDED' WHEN R.SFULL_ITEM IS NULL THEN 'REMOVED' WHEN L.SCONTENTS IS NULL AND R.SCONTENTS IS NULL THEN 'UNCHANGED' WHEN L.SCONTENTS IS NULL OR R.SCONTENTS IS NULL THEN 'MODIFIED' WHEN DBMS_LOB.COMPARE(L.SCONTENTS, R.SCONTENTS) != 0 THEN 'MODIFIED' ELSE 'UNCHANGED' END AS CHANGE_TYPE FROM L_CUM L FULL OUTER JOIN R_CUM R ON L.SFULL_ITEM = R.SFULL_ITEM ORDER BY NVL(L.SFULL_ITEM, R.SFULL_ITEM)
mapper.sql: ( SELECT pl.ILAW_ID, MAX(pl.ICATE_NO) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_CATE, MAX(pl.SGUBUN_ID) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY pl.ILAW_NO, pl.IPROM_NO) CUR_GUBUN FROM TB_PROM pl GROUP BY pl.ILAW_ID )

sql.if: AND ( PR.ILAW_ID NOT IN ( SELECT lcr.ILAW_ID FROM lcr WHERE lcr.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rr.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rr UNION SELECT ca.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE ca START WITH ca.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r WHERE r.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' ) CONNECT BY PRIOR ca.ICATE_NO = ca.IREF ) OR lcr.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT gg.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER gg ) ) OR PR.ILAW_ID IN ( SELECT lca.ILAW_ID FROM lca WHERE lca.CUR_CATE IN ( SELECT rm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER rm WHERE ( ( rm.READER_TY = 'USER' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( rm.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND rm.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) UNION SELECT cm.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE cm START WITH cm.ICATE_NO IN ( SELECT r2.ICATE_NO FROM TB_CATE_READER r2 WHERE r2.INHERIT_YN = 'Y' AND ( ( r2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( r2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND r2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) CONNECT BY PRIOR cm.ICATE_NO = cm.IREF ) OR lca.CUR_GUBUN IN ( SELECT g2.SGUBUN_ID FROM TB_GUBUN_READER g2 WHERE ( ( g2.READER_TY = 'USER' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerEsntlId} ) OR ( g2.READER_TY = 'DEPT' AND g2.READER_ID = #{readerOrgnztId} ) ) ) ) )

mapper.sql: ( SELECT c.ILAW_ID, MAX(c.ILAW_NO) CUR_NO FROM TB_PROM c WHERE c.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND c.SDISP_YN = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ILAW_ID )
mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT PV.IPVRSN_NO, PV.IPROM_NO, PV.SFULL_ITEM, PV.SITEM, PV.SSUB_ITEM, PV.SMOVE_FULL_ITEM, PV.SUNIT_TYPE, PV.SNATIVE_TYPE, PV.SSTYLE_ID, PV.ILEVEL, PV.IINDEX, PV.STITLE, PV.SCONTENTS, PV.SREASON, PV.SSEARCH_TEXT, PV.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, PV.SGAEJUNG_HIDE_YN, PV.SUSER_MODIFIED_YN, PV.SDISP_YN, PV.SSTART_DT, PV.SINS_DT, PV.SSYS_ID, SCORE(1) AS RANK FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, cn WHERE PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND CONTAINS(PV.SCONTENTS, #{keyword}, 1) > 0 AND NVL(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND cn.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND PR.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO
AND PR.ILAW_NO = ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND PV2.SFULL_ITEM = PV.SFULL_ITEM
AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO )
ORDER BY RANK DESC ) TB ) WHERE rn BETWEEN #{firstIndex}+1 AND #{firstIndex}+#{recordCountPerPage}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, cn WHERE PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND CONTAINS(PV.SCONTENTS, #{keyword}, 1) > 0 AND NVL(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
AND cn.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND PR.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO
AND PR.ILAW_NO = ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND PV2.SFULL_ITEM = PV.SFULL_ITEM AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO )
mapper.sql: ( SELECT c.ILAW_ID, MAX(c.ILAW_NO) CUR_NO, MAX(c.IPROM_NO) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY c.ILAW_NO, c.IPROM_NO) CUR_PROM, MAX(c.STITLE) KEEP (DENSE_RANK LAST ORDER BY c.ILAW_NO, c.IPROM_NO) CUR_TITLE FROM TB_PROM c WHERE c.SEXISTING_YN = 'Y' AND NVL(c.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' GROUP BY c.ILAW_ID )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT rownum rn, TB.* FROM ( SELECT 'JO' AS SRC, cn.ILAW_ID AS LAW_ID, cn.CUR_PROM AS PROM_NO, cn.CUR_TITLE AS LAW_TITLE, PV.SITEM AS ITEM, PV.SSUB_ITEM AS SUB_ITEM, PV.STITLE AS TITLE, TO_NUMBER(NULL) AS ANCHOR_NO FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, cn WHERE PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = cn.ILAW_ID AND PR.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO AND PV.SUNIT_TYPE = 'BASE_TEXT' AND NVL(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND REPLACE(NVL(PV.STITLE, CHR(1)), ' ', '') LIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{q}, ' ', '') || '%' AND PR.ILAW_NO = ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND PV2.SFULL_ITEM = PV.SFULL_ITEM AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO ) UNION ALL SELECT 'PHTML' AS SRC, cn.ILAW_ID, cn.CUR_PROM, cn.CUR_TITLE, PH.SITEM, TO_CHAR(NULL), PH.STITLE, PH.IPHTML_NO FROM TB_PROV_HTML PH, TB_PROM PR, cn WHERE PH.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = cn.ILAW_ID AND PR.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO AND NVL(PH.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(PH.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, '-') != 'NULLIFY' AND REPLACE(NVL(PH.STITLE, CHR(1)), ' ', '') LIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{q}, ' ', '') || '%' AND PR.ILAW_NO = ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_PROV_HTML PH2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PH2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND PH2.SITEM = PH.SITEM AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO ) UNION ALL SELECT 'DOCU' AS SRC, cn.ILAW_ID, cn.CUR_PROM, cn.CUR_TITLE, TO_CHAR(NULL), TO_CHAR(NULL), D.STITLE, D.IDOCU_NO FROM TB_DOCU D, TB_PROM PR, cn WHERE D.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = cn.ILAW_ID AND PR.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO AND NVL(D.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND NVL(D.SGAEJUNG_TYPE, '-') != 'NULLIFY' AND REPLACE(NVL(D.STITLE, CHR(1)), ' ', '') LIKE '%' || REPLACE(#{q}, ' ', '') || '%' AND PR.ILAW_NO = ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) FROM TB_DOCU D2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE D2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = PR.ILAW_ID AND D2.SITEM = D.SITEM AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= cn.CUR_NO ) ORDER BY 2, 1, 5 ) TB ) WHERE rn <= 80
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV, TB_PROM PR, ( SELECT MAX(PR2.ILAW_NO) AS ILAW_NO, PV2.SFULL_ITEM AS SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN PV2, TB_PROM PR2 WHERE PV2.IPROM_NO = PR2.IPROM_NO AND PR2.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PR2.ILAW_NO <= #{lawNo} GROUP BY PV2.SFULL_ITEM ) M WHERE PV.SFULL_ITEM = M.SFULL_ITEM AND PR.ILAW_NO = M.ILAW_NO AND PR.ILAW_ID = #{lawId} AND PV.IPROM_NO = PR.IPROM_NO AND NVL(PV.SDISP_YN, 'Y') = 'Y'
SELECT SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} GROUP BY SFULL_ITEM HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 ORDER BY SFULL_ITEM

SELECT SFULL_ITEM FROM TB_PROV_VRSN WHERE IPROM_NO = #{promNo} AND (SCONTENTS IS NULL OR DBMS_LOB.GETLENGTH(SCONTENTS) = 0)
AND NVL(SUNIT_TYPE, 'BASE_TEXT') != 'BASE_TEXT_GROUP' ORDER BY SFULL_ITEM
